title: PeanutsChat
description: Direct message anyone on the server! You can even mine and walk while having chat open! Group DMs built-in!
body:
Direct messaging someone has never been easier. Now that PeanutsChat is here, you don't have to share a small chat window with everyone else on the server anymore! You know what I'm talking about 😈 

Never lose your chats in game again!

![Docked Mini Layout](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ae6047dd76681fd312797d5c7f0c77c9735072e0_0.webp)


### Features

- 1:1 DMs and Group DMs
- Full screen layout
- Mini docked layout, you can keep doing whatever you're doing while the chat is open! Press a key to focus on the chat and type. Switch between chats easily
  *Layouts are saved for the next time you join the server again
- You can drag the mini layout anywhere on the screen!
- Click outside of mini chat or press Esc to defocus! Press a hotkey to focus on chat again!
- Reply to someone in chat
- Bookmark messages
- Read receipts
- Unsend messages within 5 minutes
- Mention @name
- Share your coordinates
- Share held item, good for checking interest before trading!
- Push notifications as Toast so you know if someone messaged you even without having chat open
- Highlight text in message input and cut copy paste.
- Right click context menu to copy text in message bubble.
- Pin, archive messages
- Unread message count
- /whisper someone in chat and it will be viewable in the DM UI
- To-do list - You can write whatever you want
- Rebindable hotkeys!
- IME Support, type in Chinese, Japanese, Korean, whatever you want

- OP Tools
- /peanutschats commands for OPs
- Report a user and it will be sent to server operators
- Audit log

### Security & Privacy
- End-to-end encryption - Your chats will never be seen by anyone else, even the admins of the server you're playing on.
- Your message history is saved locally on your own PC, not server-side.

AND MORE!

### How to use 

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| **`\\`** (backslash) | Open / close chat panel |
| **`]`** (right bracket) | Toggle full ↔ mini overlay |
| **Esc** (in mini mode) | Blur input — resume mining/moving |
| **Enter** | Send message |
| **Ctrl+C / V / X / A** | Standard clipboard + select all |
| **Right-click bubble** | Copy / Reply / Bookmark / Report / Unsend menu |


### Requirements

Install on both the server and every client.

Should work with mods like Essential.

### Feedback

Let me know via Discord if you have any feedback!

If you really like the mod and would like to donate, it would be greatly appreciated!

I prefer making mods that actually bring something new to the table rather than reskins of existing content in game, if that's up your alley, any donation would motivate me greatly to make more innovative mods/improve my released mods! If you aren't comfortable donating/can't afford to do so(which is completely fine), sharing and letting others know of the mods will help greatly as well! Cheers!
